title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Building a Balanced Sample Portfolio

questions.text: What is the first step before selecting investments for a balanced portfolio?
options: Define your goal, time horizon, and risk tolerance
Pick a single asset class to simplify management
Invest all funds in defensive assets
questions.explanation: The narration states you must define goal, timeline, and risk tolerance before buying assets.

questions.text: True or false: Diversifying across different asset classes can help cushion the blow if one investment performs poorly.
questions.explanation: The narration explains that spreading investments protects you when a single stock takes a hit.
